policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.
policy.forbidden: the MLPerf Inference results repositories (mlcommons/inference_results_*), published MLPerf submissions, or the MLCommons results tables

tasks.task_prompt: Run `python -u main.py --lg-model-name llama3_1-8b-edge --scenario Offline --accuracy --vllm` (edge) at the README precision over the 5,000-sample CNN/DailyMail validation subset in DATASET_FILE, then evaluation.py on its LoadGen accuracy log.

log_lines.torch cuda:: the value of `torch.cuda.is_available()` and the GPU names, written by the process that runs the model
